findings.problem: Context: total billed TOKENS. «Всего к оплате» ('total amount due') makes a money/payment claim the row does not make.

Count-agreement class (RU-002/RU-006), missed. There is no plural arm, so the bare «{count} вызовов» renders «1 вызовов», «21 вызовов» and «2 вызовов», all ungrammatical. English has no ICU plural here either, so the fix is the count-neutral label form the translator used elsewhere.
